data.name: Jason
data.gender_notes: Jason is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Jason is recorded in name-lists as “Jupiter's healer”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jason expresses “Jupiter's healer”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jason total 14, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: יאסון
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יאסון הוא שם עברי שמקורו ביוונית, הוא נגזר מהמילה ιαση, שפירושה ריפוי או מרפא, והוא משמש כשם פרטי במסורת הנוצרית

in_greek.name: Ιάσων
in_greek.long_meaning: ο Ιάσων είναι ελληνικό όνομα που προέρχεται από το ρήμα ιάομαι, που σημαίνει να θεραπεύω ή να ιάομαι, και χρησιμοποιείται ως ανδρικό όνομα στην πρώιμη χριστιανική εκκλησία

in_latin.name: Jason
in_latin.long_meaning: Jason est nomen latinum quod derivatur a verbo sanare, quod significat sanare seu curare, et utitur nomine proprio in traditione christiana
